description: Ideal gain model: V_out = D/(1-D) * V_in (inverting), efficiency eta=0.88 constant. Duty cycle D range [0.1, 0.9].

unit.name: Generic Buck-Boost Converter (Inverting)
unit.source: Erickson, R.W. & Maksimovic, D. (2001). Fundamentals of Power Electronics, 2nd ed. Springer; Kazimierczuk, M.K. (2015). Pulse-Width Modulated DC-DC Power Converters, 2nd ed. Wiley

eta.note: Overall converter efficiency (lumped; includes switching and conduction losses)

unit.note_polarity: Buck-boost output is inverted: V_out = -D/(1-D)*V_in for ideal inverting topology
